gloss: foreign land; place away from home

definitions.gloss: a place away from home; unfamiliar land
definitions.explanation: A place other than one's hometown, where one lives or travels as an outsider. A somewhat literary word that carries connotations of loneliness or longing for home.

examples.japanese: {他郷|たきょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
{他郷|たきょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寂|さび}しかった→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧。
examples.english: Life away from home was lonely.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{他郷|たきょう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧、⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧しか⟦{帰|かえ}らなかった→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: He left for a distant land to work when he was young and returned to his hometown only once every few years.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{他|た}→他：03381_ta⟧ (other) + {郷|きょう} (home region, village). A somewhat literary word for a place away from one's hometown, often coloured by loneliness or homesickness. Its antonym is ⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧ (hometown).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {他郷|たきょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live away from home
- {他郷|たきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち}: a foreign land; distant soil
- {他郷|たきょう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to leave for a distant place

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{異郷|いきょう}→異郷：26218_ikyou⟧: foreign land; strange country — stresses unfamiliarity, often abroad
- ⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧: hometown — the antonym; the place one comes from
